<?php
namespace Tests;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\{Test, Before, DataProvider, DataProviderExternal};
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
class RequestTest {
 #[Before(10)] function setup() { $this->get('/setup'); }
 #[Test, DataProvider('cases'), DataProviderExternal(Providers::class, 'external', validateArgumentCount: false)]
 public function request() { $this->helper('/helper'); $id = 42; $this->actingAs($user)->get('/users/'.$id); $this->get(route('named', ['id' => $user->id])); Model::factory(); Artisan::call('list'); $this->artisan('queue:work'); }
 private function helper($uri) { $this->get($uri); $this->get($uri); }
 function test_dynamic() { $this->$method(); $this->json($verb, $uri); }
}
